pages.lesson:
LESSON: SARUFI 1.4.1 VIWAKILISHI NAFSI VIONYESHI IDADI

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi katika matini
2. kutumia viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 1.4.1 Viwakilishi nafsi vionyeshi idadi important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi katika matini
2. kutumia viwakilishi vya nafsi vionyeshi/viashiria na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
